positionList.title: HMS Analyst - 737400 - RD
positionList.summary: Seeking an HMS Analyst to support the HIE Medicaid Services (HMS) program, focusing on enhancing Medicaid quality and population health efforts through improved data exchange (including digital quality measures, health-related social needs data exchange, and care management data sharing).
positionList.description: Support the implementation, expansion, and ongoing operations of Medicaid data exchange services, with a strong focus on improving Health-Related Social Needs (HRSN) data capture and onboarding early adopters. Translate program and partner needs into technical and workflow requirements, support CCD/ADT data integration efforts, coordinate cross-team activities, and troubleshoot issues to ensure secure and accurate data connections.

positionList.title: SAP System Administrator - 737462 - RD
positionList.summary: Seeking an SAP System Administrator - Expert to serve as the SAP HANA subject matter expert for the enterprise SAP landscape that runs the systems of record, administering and supporting more than 100 production and non-production SAP HANA databases and providing SAP Basis expertise across all SAP products.
positionList.description: Administer and support over 100 production and non-production SAP HANA databases; provide SAP Basis expertise across all SAP products; coordinate and implement technical changes, patches, and upgrades; participate in the duty manager on-call rotation and daily system checks; support the in-flight migration of the landscape to SAP NS2 (S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition); execute HANA System Replication, refreshes, and system copies; apply HANA revisions, SAP kernel updates, and support package stacks; monitor database performance and capacity.

positionList.title: QA Analyst Sr / Tricentis Tosca TA - 737392 - MK
positionList.summary: Seeking a Tricentis Tosca Testing Analyst to support test automation strategy and execution for a large-scale SAP S/4HANA transformation program. The role will develop and maintain automated test assets, execute testing activities, support end-to-end business process validation, and contribute to SIT, UAT, regression testing, defect management, and deployment readiness efforts.
positionList.description:
Key Responsibilities
Develop automated test cases using Tricentis Tosca.
Maintain and execute existing automated test suites.
Perform test case design and test automation.
Support test data management and test execution.
Validate end-to-end business processes.
Support System Integration Testing (SIT).
Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
Perform regression testing.
Manage and track defects.
Support deployment readiness activities.
Collaborate with functional and technical teams.
